title: feat: add YAML/JSON input support and PDF generation [ranukita:075fa6]
body:
This PR adds support for loading CV data from YAML/JSON files instead of hardcoded values, and adds PDF generation capability.

Changes:
- Added `optimizador_cv/input_loader.py` module to load data from .yaml, .yml, or .json files
- Modified `build_cv.py` to use the new input loader and support PDF output
- Added `examples/sample.yaml` as a complete example configuration
- Added automatic PDF generation when output file ends with .pdf

The project is now ready for external users to use with their own data files.
